results.description:
Master Builders 2026 House of the Year - Sunshine Coast

Conceived as a private and restrained arrival that opens dramatically to the waterfront, the residence is defined by a sweeping roofline, sculptural curved forms and a seamless connection between interior living, landscaped grounds and the water’s edge.

Azura stands as a benchmark in high-end residential construction — a home of significant architectural and technical complexity, executed with extraordinary craftsmanship.
